mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(th.amount), 0) FROM transaction_history th INNER JOIN connected_account ca ON ca.account_id = th.account_id INNER JOIN codef_connection cc ON cc.connection_id = ca.connection_id WHERE cc.user_id = #{userId} AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE' AND th.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAW' AND TRIM(COALESCE(th.transaction_description, '')) LIKE '체크카드%' AND th.transaction_datetime >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND th.transaction_datetime < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
